def git(*args,idx=None):
 env={**os.environ,'GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS':'0'}
 if idx is not None:env['GIT_INDEX_FILE']=str(idx)
 r=subprocess.run(['git','-c','gc.auto=0',*args],cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,env=env,timeout=180)
 assert r.returncode==0,(args,r.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace'),r.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace'))

paths=git('diff','--cached','--name-only',head,idx=stage_copy).decode().splitlines()
assert paths and all(p.startswith(('docs/handoffs/2026-10-25-low-','mod_nailong/data/production-checkpoint-failures/20261025-v7-','mod_nailong/data/production-resumptions/20261025-low-','mod_nailong/data/production-owner-failures/20261025-v7-','mod_nailong/data/production-review-handovers/20261025-root-')) for p in paths)

def entries(data):
 magic,version,count=struct.unpack('>4sII',data[:12]);assert magic==b'DIRC' and version==2
 pos=12;out={}
 for _ in range(count):
  start=pos;stats=data[pos:pos+40];oid=data[pos+40:pos+60];flags=struct.unpack('>H',data[pos+60:pos+62])[0];assert not flags&0x4000
  end=data.index(b'\0',pos+62);name=data[pos+62:end].decode();out[name]=(stats,oid,flags&0x3000)
  pos=start+((end-start+1+7)//8)*8
 return out

assert set(current)==set(after) and all(current[p][1:]==after[p][1:] and current[p][0][24:28]==after[p][0][24:28] for p in current)

 try:

  while len(args)>1 and args[0]=='-c' and args[1] in ['core.quotepath=false','core.fsmonitor=false']:args=args[2:]
  allowed=args in [['status','--porcelain'],['status','--short','--untracked-files=no'],['diff','--shortstat',head]]

 except psutil.NoSuchProcess:continue
